content:
BUILT CoLAB, through João Poças Martins, represented the REV@CONSTRUCTION Mobilizing Project at the second International Conference on Construction, Energy, Environment and Sustainability – CEES, which took place between June 27 and 30 in Funchal.

Organized by Itecons, in collaboration with the National Research Council of Canada’s (NRC) Construction Research Centre, the event brought together professionals from the construction, energy and environmental fields, promoting discussion around some of the biggest challenges facing national and international industries.

It was therefore the ideal opportunity to show some of the main results of the project through a presentation by João Poças Martins, with the motto “Key results of the project for the “digital construction revolution” in Portugal”.
